reason: Headed Chromium takes its font hinting and subpixel settings from the display's toolkit, which the integration environment's bare Xvfb doesn't define, where headless Chromium uses fontconfig's: the two render the same text differently there (31,614 pixels differ; a hyphenated block is 21.01 px tall headed and 20 headless)

The page's TLS fixture uses a self-signed certificate, which a context accepts with acceptInsecureCerts. Chromium refuses acceptInsecureCerts with Unsupported, because its certificate override applies to the whole browser
